rows.reason: Four of the five official forms this family names do not resolve to any held document. data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/source-custody-reconciliation.json records il-prb-cert-set as custodyClass SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED, documentSourcesNamed 5, documentSourcesResolved 1, commissionAcquisition true, with absence 'label_does_not_identify_a_document' on each of: official-form:PRB Certificate of Sealing Application, official-form:PRB Certificate of Sealing Eligibility Acknowledgement, official-form:PRB Certificate of Expungement for Military Application, official-form:PRB Certificate of Expungement for Military Eligibility Acknowledgement. Components il-prb-cert-primary-filing-1 and il-prb-cert-attachment-2 carry requirement 'required' and depend on the first two. The builder contract's first item is to bind every source by exact SHA-256 and stop the family rather than build on a source that does not bind, so the family stops.
rows.absenceVerifiedNotAssumed: No file named PRB* exists anywhere under the mounted Master Library or private/. The committed corpus index carries 27 Illinois entries and none is a PRB certificate. IL.memo.json describes the Sealing Application as '5 pages, 55 fields, fillable AcroForm, revised 09/18/2024' and points at a private/Nationwide Record Clearing path that is not mounted here; it pins no SHA-256, so there is nothing to bind against even in principle.

findingsRaisedForOthers.finding: MASTER_QUEUE.json records sourceStatus SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES, sourceBound true and sourceReadiness.ready true with an empty reasons array for all three of these families, while source-custody-reconciliation.json classes two of them custodyClass SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and every Montana document source is an unfillable, generation-disabled DOCX. The queue's readiness is computed over the sources that resolved, not over the components the routes require, so it reports ready for families that cannot produce a packet.
findingsRaisedForOthers.risk: A lane trusting sourceReadiness.ready would build against sources that cannot carry a packet, or would treat an absent required form as satisfied.
findingsRaisedForOthers.affectedBeyondThisLane: unknown to this lane; the field is computed the same way for all 346 queue families and is worth a sweep.

findingsRaisedForOthers.finding: The family_sources_bind preflight check reports ok when the sources it can resolve all bind, and silently excludes form labels that resolve to no document ('label_does_not_identify_a_document') from its denominator. il-prb-cert-set reports 'ok — 1/1 source(s) bind' while four of its five official forms, two of them required, are held nowhere.
findingsRaisedForOthers.risk: The row gate's headline reads as source readiness but measures only resolved sources. A lane that treats a green row gate as permission to build would start a family whose required forms do not exist.
findingsRaisedForOthers.suggestion: Report the named-versus-resolved ratio in the check's detail line, or fail when a family's unresolved labels back a required component.

findingsRaisedForOthers.finding: The assignment's required output paths, data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf16/rows.json and checkpoints.json, were already occupied at the base commit by the PF-C cohort's committed return for two COMPLETED families. BUILD-B previously hit the same collision and wrote build-b-rows.json beside it. Three cohorts now share one lane directory under three naming schemes.
findingsRaisedForOthers.risk: An integrator reading only pf16/rows.json sees PF-C's two rows and misses BUILD-B's and this cohort's. Rows can be lost silently, which is the exact failure the assignment warns about when it says a lane returning fewer rows than assigned has lost work silently.
findingsRaisedForOthers.suggestion: Give each cohort a distinct, declared filename in the dispatch, or have the Captain merge the cohorts explicitly.

findingsRaisedForOthers.finding: The Illinois packet-set manifest and IL.memo.json both describe four PRB certificate forms with concrete detail — the Sealing Application as '5 pages, 55 fields, fillable AcroForm, revised 09/18/2024' — and point at private/Nationwide Record Clearing paths. No such file exists in this container, none is in the committed corpus index, and neither record pins a SHA-256 for them.
findingsRaisedForOthers.risk: A record that describes a form's page count and field count reads as evidence the form is held. Here the description exists and the document does not.
findingsRaisedForOthers.suggestion: Either bind these four to acquired bytes with pinned digests, or mark them explicitly as commission-acquisition targets in the manifest as the custody reconciliation already does.

captainQuestions: il-prb-cert-set: the four PRB certificate forms are recorded commissionAcquisition true and are held nowhere. Should this family wait for acquisition, or be re-scoped to the EXP-AD stage-2 petition alone? A build lane cannot make that scoping decision.

il-prb-cert-set: route il-prb-cert-nonmilitary-expungement-branch (§ 5.2(e-6)) has no recorded output treatment. Which instrument serves it? This is a legal-design input; PF16 did not research or guess it.

mt_misdemeanor_expungement-set and mt_mmrta_completed-set: every Montana form in the corpus is a DOCX and three are source-gated with generation_allowed no. Both families are declared wholly or partly official_pdf_fill against sources that cannot be filled. Does the Captain intend to acquire official PDF renditions, or to re-declare these families' output strategy? Either is a decision above this lane.
